summary: Iteration 24 — Retest of two remaining icon-mode issues from iteration_23 (artist dropzone previews + 1440/1540 viewport-centered tabs) plus regression quick pass. Both fixes verified PASS end-to-end on the preview URL. Admin flow and regression (mobile 390 dock, My changes drawer, settings in icon mode) also pass.
critical_code_review_comments: songcoder.html:2562 wireMiniDrop() now has sync() that reads the url input, sets d.style.backgroundImage from it and toggles .has-file. Called on init so Edit for existing artist renders the current photo/banner as the dropzone preview. Also wired as input listener so typing/pasting a new URL updates live and clearing empties. local[kind] (file drop) short-circuits sync so a dropped file preview is not overwritten by the url field. Clean fix.

songcoder.html:85-86 'body.icon-mode .tabs{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}' + 'body.icon-mode .topbar::after{content:\'\';order:2;flex-basis:100%;height:0;margin-bottom:-12px}' pushes .tabs to its own row via a flex-basis:100% pseudo-element, letting margin:auto center the tabs row on the viewport. Verified mathematically centered (tabsMid == viewportMid) at 800/1024/1440/1540. At >=1541 the ::after rule falls out of the (max-width:1540) media block so tabs sit back in the top bar as expected. Admin 4-tab layout at 761-1540 is unchanged (full-width row, topbar::after content: 'none').
